reuse.why: Hooks the new check into the existing ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked precondition that all six provider link functions already call, so no call site needs changing.

duplication.why: The closed-account rule is written once and invoked from one place.

placement.why: It sits with the other link preconditions in server/accounts/app.ts; calling it from inside a function named ...IsNotLinked slightly hides a second, unrelated rule behind that name.

scope.why: A small helper, one call and a test.

maintainability.why: Minimal and centrally enforced; a future reader may not expect the 'not linked' guard to also reject closed accounts.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The change goes through the existing link precondition.

one_place.where: ensureAccountIsOpenForLinking is called once from ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked in server/accounts/app.ts, which every provider link function (GoCardless, SimpleFin, Pluggy, Akahu, Enable Banking, Fintegra) already calls.
